title: WebSocket upgrade failed with 500: logging middleware hid http.Hijacker
symptom: Every realtime client failed to connect; mobile sync over WebSocket broke. gorilla/websocket Upgrade returned 500 'response does not implement http.Hijacker' and the handler swallowed the error.
how_diagnosed: Upgrade error text traced to the statusRecorder wrapper in the observability logging middleware, which only reimplemented WriteHeader.
delay_reason: The wrapper dates from structured telemetry work (b1f7ccdd, 2026-04-13) but the records do not say when the WS path first broke or was first noticed.

title: Mobile-set anime state silently rewritten to Finalizado
symptom: Marking a fully-watched anime En pausa / No me gusto / Viendo from the phone stored Finalizado instead.
how_diagnosed: Mobile's buildSetEstadoPatch always ships episodesWatched with status; ApplyCompletionStateMachine forced estado=1 when nrocapvisto>=totalcap. The activity log recorded the requested estado, not the stored one, which hid the overwrite; diagnosis needed the request body vs the stored snapshot.
delay_reason: No record of when the state machine started overriding explicit estado; the audit log masked it.

title: Reconcile cursor rewound to 0 after a fully acknowledged changelog
symptom: Once every paired device acknowledged, rows were pruned and the reported cursor fell to 0; a trusting client would restart from the beginning of history.
how_diagnosed: Found while diagnosing a 43-hour background-sync freeze with the mobile team; measured across four paired devices over the retained capture window (no shipped client actually rewound).
delay_reason: Latent trap; no client had hit it, so there is no first-occurrence time.

title: Captured Bearer tokens persisted in plaintext in request_captures
symptom: Never-expiring device auth tokens were stored verbatim in captured request headers in a DB that is copied with backups.
how_diagnosed: Noticed while reading captured request headers during the background-sync freeze investigation; eventlog already redacted the same data, showing drift.
delay_reason: Header capture existed since the capture sidecar (2026-07-24) until the 2026-09-03 fix, about six weeks.

title: Mobile background sync frozen for up to 43-46 h with the app closed
symptom: Mobile only synced while open (WS foreground-only); bridge saw 0-capture days and gaps up to 46.2 h.
how_diagnosed: Three weeks of bridge request_captures and mobile cycle telemetry (last_stage, consecutive_unclosed_cycles) correlated with the 1.3.0 install timestamp; device dumpsys/logcat; root cause on mobile: Expo modules declared 'modulesClassNames' instead of 'modules', so native seams were no-ops.
delay_reason: Last healthy cycle close 2026-09-15 23:35; investigation logged from 2026-09-19.

title: Phone-marked episodes dated at sync time, not watch time
symptom: History showed offline-watched episodes 15-24 h late, all collapsed onto the reconnect instant; owner reported it as a time-zone bug.
how_diagnosed: Read-only queries on bridge.db: watched_at_ms vs anime_snapshots lastWatchedAt; runtime_events 6551-6565 showed the phone WS registering at 19:02:02 and four queued patches applied in the same second. Stored rows corrected later from per-operation capture evidence.
delay_reason: Watch history shipped with SDD-69 around 2026-09-12; found 2026-09-13 while polishing the History UI.

title: Every editor save wiped the anime's scheduled days
symptom: Saving any field in the Anime Editor cleared the anime's schedule; eight animes lost their schedule between 2026-07-15 and 2026-08-29.
how_diagnosed: append([]T{}, nil...) produced an empty non-nil Placements slice read as 'clear all'. Counting casualties needed change history per anime (seven had been unknowingly repaired by rescheduling).
delay_reason: Learning log says it silently wiped schedules for six weeks (2026-07-15 to 2026-08-29).

title: Changelog changed_fields always [] for six weeks
symptom: Six producers of AnimeChangedEvent never set ChangedFields, so every changelog row (served to mobile) carried an empty list.
how_diagnosed: SDD-64 decision-grade metrics inspected changelog rows; the fix derives the set from committed before/after snapshots.
delay_reason: Learning log states the changelog logged [] for six weeks.

title: Anime creates reached Mobile as update
symptom: Every create reached the changelog, changes feed and WebSocket as change_type 'update' / anime_changed instead of create / anime_created.
how_diagnosed: The outbox never derived a change type and the publish seam had no slot; diagnosis needed the feed/WS payloads plus whether anime_snapshots held a row before the upsert.
delay_reason: Has existed since the outbox publisher; no first-observation date recorded.

title: Changelog rows could carry an older snapshot than an earlier row, reverting patches on Mobile
symptom: A desktop edit could be undone on a phone: installed Mobile builds diff the whole snapshot and applied a later row carrying a pre-patch snapshot.
how_diagnosed: Blocker B2 reported by Mobile; race verified in code (announce reads snapshot, then publishes; insert in a separate transaction); RED tests with concurrent writers, stale payloads and equal millisecond clocks.
delay_reason: Race found by cross-team contract review, not by a dated user report.

title: Changelog prune dropped the per-anime clock floor
symptom: After every device acknowledged and rows were pruned, a new change could tie or fall behind a timestamp a phone already applied, so the phone could skip it.
how_diagnosed: Advisory A5 in verification; RED test showed the next change stamped 90 below the acknowledged 120.
delay_reason: Surfaced the same day the per-anime clock was introduced (a64a7bc5).

title: Sync diagnostics with new mobile events refused with 400
symptom: Mobile reports carrying native_module_unavailable or remote_change_rejected were rejected by strict /api/sync/diagnostics.
how_diagnosed: Closed vocabulary in syncdiag lacked the two events Mobile already sent; seen as refused diagnostics requests.
delay_reason: Mobile started emitting the events in builds just before the fix; exact onset unrecorded.

title: Desktop read device sync diagnostics from a table nothing wrote
symptom: Device diagnostics view showed only older reports, never a live one.
how_diagnosed: Write path had moved to the kind-discriminated store (2f909283); git grep found zero production writers of device_sync_diagnostics; verified by storing a report through the write path and reading it back.
delay_reason: Regression and fix landed the same day (2026-09-24).

title: Device connection_status could never read 'connected'
symptom: Healthy devices always rendered as disconnected in the Devices panel.
how_diagnosed: connection_status was derived (and inverted) from sync_status; the real signal, WS client register/unregister in the realtime hub, was never consulted.
delay_reason: Noted as out of scope in 812e9bfc the same day; original onset not recorded.

title: Devices panel did not refresh on device sync or pairing
symptom: Last sync stayed stale and a newly paired device did not appear until the route remounted.
how_diagnosed: First fix subscribed to device-acknowledged, which never fires on POST /api/devices/pair; second fix subscribed to pairing.token-consumed emitted after a successful pair.
delay_reason: Panel had been mount-only since it existed; first report date not recorded.

title: Sync conflict failed the whole reconcile exchange
symptom: One stale operation made the whole reconcile return 500, losing applied operations, pending changes and the changelog position for the batch.
how_diagnosed: Contract review with mobile (sync contract fixes branch); path was unreachable in practice because no client sent base.
delay_reason: Never hit in production; found by contract analysis.

title: OCC token never echoed to Mobile, leaving stale writes unprotected
symptom: applied_operations carried no modified_at and bridge_changes hardcoded modified_at 0, so mobile could not send a base; stale mobile writes could clobber newer desktop values.
how_diagnosed: Mobile team measured 135 of 143 production rows with token 0; wire shape and stored tokens inspected.
delay_reason: OCC built in SDD-30 (2026-06-23) without a wire echo until 2026-09-04.

title: Reconcile soft-deleted Bridge-native animes at startup
symptom: Season-created animes vanished from Chapters on the next startup.
how_diagnosed: Startup catch-up reconcile soft-deleted ids absent from Legacy animes.dat; two known casualties identified in the DB and restored by a one-time repair.
delay_reason: SDD-30 reconcile shipped 2026-06-23; when the first casualty occurred is not recorded.

title: PATCH writeback reported success before durable append
symptom: PATCH /api/animes/:id returned success even when the append to animes.dat failed (silent false-positive success).
how_diagnosed: Commit makes append failures surface as HTTP errors and an anime.write.failed bus event; diagnosis details not recorded.
delay_reason: No investigation record.

title: Pairing token not refreshed after consumption
symptom: After a device paired, the pairing panel kept the consumed token.
how_diagnosed: Not recorded; fix adds a consumed-token callback from router to desktop.
delay_reason: Commit has no body and no doc entry.

title: Today panel did not update on anime.changed (no desktop leg)
symptom: Writes from mobile, REST or downloads reached mobile WS clients but the desktop Today view updated only after navigating away and back.
how_diagnosed: Traced bus subscribers: realtime hub, changelog recorder and others got the event, but the only bus-to-Wails bridge iterated download.* names.
delay_reason: Behavior existed since the bus bridge was written; remount masked it.

title: Tracer bullet published a fake anime.changed at startup
symptom: Desktop received a change notice for nonexistent 'tracer-bullet-anime' at every startup.
how_diagnosed: Runtime bus events at startup compared with anime_snapshots; the demo runner published outside the outbox.
delay_reason: The desktop leg forwarding anime.changed existed since 2026-08-02; fixed 2026-10-16.

title: anime.changed announced for writes never persisted
symptom: A writer published anime.changed for writes that were not committed, so consumers (mobile WS, changelog) could see changes that did not exist.
how_diagnosed: Comparing published events with committed rows; fix made the outbox drain the only publisher.
delay_reason: Learning log gives only the fix date.

title: Capture rows recorded a hardcoded 500 for real error statuses
symptom: Captured PATCH/reconcile telemetry could never show the real 4xx status or the bridge's own error body.
how_diagnosed: responseStatus(w) only worked with httptest.ResponseRecorder; replaced with a capturingResponseWriter recording true status and body.
delay_reason: Capture shipped 2026-07-23/24 and was fixed 2026-07-24.

title: Capture omitted successful responses and showed terminal rows as pending
symptom: No truncation signal, successful response bodies omitted, no wire-faithful request body; transport-only terminal rows kept ticking as in-flight.
how_diagnosed: Inspecting captured transactions in the Activity inspector against what was sent and returned.
delay_reason: Capture added 2026-07-23; hotfix 2026-07-25.

title: Orphaned pending capture rows ticking for ~13.7 h
symptom: A capture row stuck at outcome=pending with a duration counter growing to ~13.7 h.
how_diagnosed: Four sibling rows terminated within ~2 s of each other (mass termination = shutdown) and the same route answered 404 in 0 ms after restart; the arrival row was stranded by process death.
delay_reason: Row stranded at shutdown; investigated after about 13.7 h, under a day.

title: Early-boot runtime events dropped before the sink was bound
symptom: UI showed seven tracer-bullet events while the request MCP retrieved only one from runtime_events.
how_diagnosed: Compared memLogger ring buffer vs runtime_events table; startup order showed the tracer bullet ran before Sink.Bind; the lone survivor was the first emission after Bind.
delay_reason: Found while building the runtime-events MCP read path the same day.

title: Correlation timeline matched captures on a request id no event carries
symptom: get_correlation_timeline would return a permanently half-empty timeline while reporting success.
how_diagnosed: Capture request_id is minted per handler and never reaches domain events; real correlation ids are anime.patch:<id>:<ts>, run ids or client correlationId. The original test was self-fulfilling.
delay_reason: Caught during implementation of the tool.

title: search_requests returned items: null and broke its MCP schema
symptom: A zero-match capture search became a hard MCP tool error ('want array').
how_diagnosed: MCP output schema validation error; the nil slice marshalled as null; the existing test asserted len != 0.
delay_reason: No first-occurrence date.

title: get_request_context on a miss returned a protocol error
symptom: Looking up a nonexistent request id failed the MCP call instead of returning not-found; resolve_request_context returned unbounded candidates.
how_diagnosed: Reproduced twice from the MCP client and by reading the Go source: zero-value record with operation_refs: null violated the output schema.
delay_reason: Found incidentally during the mobile background-sync investigation; resolution not dated.

title: Mobile cycle outcome mislabelled never_closed
symptom: 318 of 320 telemetry rows reported never_closed although 25 carried last_stage=closed with zero unclosed cycles.
how_diagnosed: Reading mobile cycle telemetry stored in the bridge; derivePreviousCycleOutcome let the stuck flag outrank the stage.
delay_reason: Instrumentation began 2026-09-09/11; mislabel found around 2026-09-19/21.

title: Second instance losing the HTTP bind left Downloads readiness unavailable
symptom: Downloads panels reported 'Download readiness unavailable'.
how_diagnosed: runtime_events showed two 'tracer bullet ready' and one 'http server listening', proving a second process lost the bind; startupErr gated startup before download orchestration.
delay_reason: Not recorded when it first occurred.

title: No single-instance guard: N windows and N tray icons
symptom: Every launch spawned a full second process with its own window and tray icon.
how_diagnosed: Observed duplicate processes; options.App lacked SingleInstanceLock.
delay_reason: Present since the app shell was built; first report not dated.

title: Test binaries registered themselves for Windows login start
symptom: Bridge did not launch at sign-in; Task Manager showed Autoreas-bridge.test.
how_diagnosed: HKCU Run value pointed at a deleted %TEMP%\go-build...\autoreas-bridge.test.exe written by go test calling app.startup.
delay_reason: Windows startup was enabled 2026-08-02 and fixed 2026-08-03.

title: Tray icon went deaf after running a while
symptom: Tray icon visible but ignored clicks; Abrir/Salir did nothing while the app kept running.
how_diagnosed: systray.Run on an unpinned goroutine; a probe saw the loop migrate across 21 OS threads.
delay_reason: Intermittent and dependent on uptime; onset not recorded.

title: Stale wails dev process made the Legacy cut look broken
symptom: After SDD-55 the animes.dat watcher still appeared live at runtime.
how_diagnosed: A wails dev process launched before the change was still running; clean-process runtime check resolved it.
delay_reason: Found during SDD-55 verification.

title: wails dev auto-restart ran a new data-mutating startup step on the real DB
symptom: Editing Go sources rebuilt and restarted the app, which ran a new startup data rewrite against the real bridge.db before it was decided.
how_diagnosed: Noticed restart and its effect on bridge.db; data rewrite moved to a one-off run.
delay_reason: Happened during the SDD-73 session.

title: Backup import blanked the window (nil slices as JSON null)
symptom: The first successful same-version import threw a TypeError and blanked the window.
how_diagnosed: Frontend .length/.map on null; only the serialized json.Marshal shape showed it.
delay_reason: Import shipped and failed in the same session.

title: Backups omitted watch history
symptom: A full restore looked complete while History stayed empty.
how_diagnosed: Only a VM restore surfaced the missing watched_episodes group (DB state after restore).
delay_reason: watch_history shipped ~2026-09-12; found 2026-09-16.

title: Editor DTO omitempty dropped tipo=0 and caused endless no_op save loop
symptom: Type field emptied for 'Anime (TV)' (tipo=0), forcing an endless no_op save loop.
how_diagnosed: Serialized DTO shape vs stored value; omitempty dropped a legitimate zero.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: RunOnce progress stuck at zero then published stale counters
symptom: Persisted run row stayed at zero and live progress was hidden; later an older worker could publish stale counters.
how_diagnosed: Run row in DB and progress events compared; aggregation and persistence ordering fixed.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: Cancelled download runs left as running, relabelled interrupted at startup
symptom: Stopping a download left the run row 'running' until next startup labelled it 'interrupted'.
how_diagnosed: Terminal write used the cancelled context and failed; seen in run rows across restart.
delay_reason: Found while building the stop button.

title: Hoster priority saved to site 'default' that nothing read
symptom: Every reorder looked saved but downloads kept the seeded order.
how_diagnosed: DB rows written under site 'default' while GetDownloadConfig and the resolver read 'jkanime'.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: Opaque hoster filename parsed as episode 90 marked anime up to date
symptom: A 12-episode catch-up ended after one file and the anime was marked up to date forever.
how_diagnosed: Download run events/outcomes showed the cursor jump; 'd2ouiemgt90z.mp4' parsed as 90.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: jkanime pagination: every series stalled at episode 16
symptom: Runs logged a clean download.up_to_date while episode 17 was published (Slime 4th Season sat at 16).
how_diagnosed: Caught on the 2026-08-09 scheduled run: runtime events said up_to_date while disk and site disagreed; listing was page 1 of 16 only.
delay_reason: Manifests only once a series passes episode 16; caught on a scheduled run.

title: Finished hoster declared dead and its package deleted
symptom: A hoster that finished inside the detect blind gap was classified dead, its JD package deleted, and the episode credited to a fallback.
how_diagnosed: SDD-61 instrumented every terminal point via logf metadata into runtime_events to make it measurable, then the fix.
delay_reason: Instrumentation was built to confirm it; onset not recorded.

title: Same episode downloaded twice from two hosters
symptom: With several anime downloading at once, an episode was transferred twice and extra attempts piled up as errors.
how_diagnosed: Not recorded beyond 'two separate faults combined'.
delay_reason: No investigation record.

title: Create batch failed with 'anime id is required'
symptom: Adding an anime to the schedule failed.
how_diagnosed: Error text traced to a zero BatchOperation staged when the reflow changed nothing.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: Sin Ver rows froze chapter availability at creation time
symptom: AvailableChapters never updated, even via 'Re-check now'.
how_diagnosed: RecheckAvailability skipped every created row; stored counts did not move.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: Activity renderer froze with a pinned core and no error
symptom: Skeleton frozen, one core at 100% for 35+ min, memory to 2.8 GB, nothing in console or Go log.
how_diagnosed: Captured live over CDP against the real WebView2 renderer; React Aria focus-fixup loop on an all-disabled collection.
delay_reason: Onset not recorded.

title: Logger domain polluted with prose
symptom: runtime_events.domain held whole sentences, breaking forensics by domain.
how_diagnosed: Inspecting runtime_events domains during SDD-64 metrics work.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: checktruncation reported 'clean' after scanning zero rows
symptom: Truncation check printed clean on a pre-SDD-56 DB whose snapshots used 'dias' not 'days'.
how_diagnosed: Comparison against stored snapshot_json keys in anime_snapshots.
delay_reason: Found when the checker was introduced.

title: Cover ETag changed when source file moved, mobile dropped its image
symptom: A cover served from the user's file path stopped loading once the file moved; mobile lost the cached image instead of revalidating with 304.
how_diagnosed: Cover route responses and If-None-Match revalidation behaviour.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: Display-boundary sanitization hid 212 stored diagnostics reports
symptom: 212 stored mobile diagnostics reports were unreadable on every surface.
how_diagnosed: Counting stored reports in the DB against what the surfaces showed.
delay_reason: Diagnostics ingestion added 2026-09-08; found 2026-09-19.

title: Backend event navigation.open had no frontend consumer
symptom: 'Open Downloads' pressed green and never navigated.
how_diagnosed: Emitted notification.navigate runtime event had zero subscribers in frontend/src.
delay_reason: No onset recorded.

title: Sync endpoints return 500 because of malformed changelog rows
symptom: Mobile bug report: GET /api/animes/changes and POST /api/sync/reconcile both returned HTTP 500 while GET /api/animes still worked.
how_diagnosed: Compared the failing endpoints with the healthy one, which pointed to the shared changelog-to-contract conversion. One corrupt changelog.snapshot_json row poisoned all incremental sync.
delay_reason: The memory does not say when the corrupt row was written or when mobile first saw the 500.

title: Legacy changelog schema in the real bridge.db breaks sync endpoints
symptom: GET /api/animes/changes and POST /api/sync/reconcile failed with 500 on the user's real database, while GET /api/animes worked.
how_diagnosed: Inspected the real bridge.db and found the old changelog(id, anime_id, payload_json, status) schema. The fix added a bootstrap migration.
delay_reason: The schema drift was latent from an earlier version, and the memory has no first-failure timestamp.

title: Inbound WebSocket reconcile messages are discarded, and REST reconcile ignored pending operations
symptom: Mobile sync activity never updated legacy animes.dat. Client messages reached the socket but changed nothing.
how_diagnosed: Reviewed the whole mobile-to-bridge workflow. The WS handler called conn.ReadMessage() and dropped every payload, and REST reconcile did not apply pending_operations. An end-to-end test proved the writeback.
delay_reason: No record of when mobile started relying on these paths.

title: Reconcile contract gaps: watch time overwritten by server time, no cursor or per-operation ack
symptom: Mobile marked operations synced on any 202 and could not tell ignored operations from applied ones. Client fechaUltCapVisto was replaced with server time.
how_diagnosed: Audited the real mobile request flow (#2066) against the bridge handlers. Added last_changelog_id, applied_operations[] and client fechaUltCapVisto support.
delay_reason: This was found during a contract audit after an incident; its start is not recorded.

title: Mobile initial sync fails because the bridge emits generos:null
symptom: Mobile prod APK: 'pairing completed but initial sync failed'. Pairing worked, but the client rejected GET /api/animes.
how_diagnosed: Called GET /api/animes on the running bridge with a real device token from the devices table: all 842 snapshots had generos:null. The mobile zod schema rejects null. The cause was a Go nil-slice regression in the uncommitted SDD-49 refactor. A first diagnosis (reconcile soft-delete) was wrong.
delay_reason: The regression lived in an uncommitted WIP branch the user was running; it was found when a prod APK paired.

title: Devices 'Syncing Now' only cleared because prune emptied the changelog
symptom: Changelog rows never left 'pending'. The panel only looked correct because pruning removed rows, which also removed the per-anime clock floor.
how_diagnosed: Read changelog status and device acknowledgement state. The fix keeps MAX(id) per anime and filters by minimum active device ack.
delay_reason: Found during the episode-durations work; no start date is recorded.

title: Prod Today blank: corrupt name_key index blocks write recovery and HTTP startup
symptom: Today showed 'Nothing scheduled' for every day. The Editor Repeat failed, and the HTTP API (mobile sync) never started.
how_diagnosed: On a copy of the prod DB: integrity_check through modernc, the SQLITE_CORRUPT_VTAB 779 error text, the staged row in anime_write_operations, and startup-recovery order in configureRuntimeServices. netstat showed no listening port. REINDEX with the app's own engine repaired it (#9870).
delay_reason: The failed write was at 2026-09-19 21:53 and the diagnosis was at 2026-09-20 10:28 (about 13 h).

title: Anime editor locked by a stranded staged write
symptom: After a Repeat on 'Date a Live III', every save hung: isSaving stayed true, all exits were disabled, and CPU spun at about 33%.
how_diagnosed: Found the staged operation that never finalized and the ErrWriteReservationBusy retry loop. Measured the button opacity in screenshots to prove isSaving was stuck. There was no runtime_events row for the first Finalize failure.
delay_reason: The write was staged at 21:53 and the hotfix diagnosis is dated 22:28 the same night.

title: Yani Neko re-soft-deleted every reconcile cycle (present in animes.dat as deleted)
symptom: After the SDD-48 fix, the anime kept turning inactive again about every 84 s.
how_diagnosed: Matched by exact _id in animes.dat (present with activo=false) and watched snapshot activo and modified_at across the 84 s reconcile cycle. Verified the fix held for 110 s.
delay_reason: This was a same-session follow-up to E15.

title: Duplicate anime rows: create has no dedup, and readiness includes soft-deleted animes
symptom: Two rows with the same name in Solo anime download and Editor Library.
how_diagnosed: Queried the live bridge.db: different anime_ids, one soft-deleted. Created and deleted timestamps refuted 'create duplicates in one action'. Counted 21 duplicate names out of 862 rows.
delay_reason: The deleted twins date from 2026-07-07 to 07-11 and the triage was 2026-09-02.

title: Request MCP rejects stored captures with null correlation arrays
symptom: MCP tools failed SDK output-schema validation on real data (operation_refs: null).
how_diagnosed: Ran the MCP sidecar against the real %APPDATA% bridge.db. The synthetic fixtures had always populated the arrays.
delay_reason: Found during the first real-DB test right after implementation.

title: Stale request-MCP binary exits with 'request capture schema mismatch'
symptom: autoreas-request-mcp failed with 'MCP error -32000: Connection closed'.
how_diagnosed: Ran the repo-root exe (immediate exit with a schema mismatch), checked the live DB capture schema version 5, and compared it with a fresh temp build that started cleanly.
delay_reason: Not recorded when the binary went stale.

title: Ordering board locked by appliedAt null vs undefined
symptom: Weekday cards could not be dragged, and 'Reopen ordering' did nothing for a never-applied schedule.
how_diagnosed: Verified that the backend reopen cleared applied_at, then found that the Wails binding returned null, which the frontend treated as applied.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Ordering weekday duplicates poison persisted ordering state
symptom: The same anime could be placed twice in one weekday column and then autosaved or applied.
how_diagnosed: Found that the invariant was enforced only in the drag helper. Added backend apply validation.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Out-of-order staged-write finalize regresses modified_at
symptom: Finalizing an older staged operation after a newer one regressed modified_at and the canonical JSON.
how_diagnosed: A deterministic exported-API probe finalized token 300, then 200, and observed modified_at=200. Fixed with a CAS guard (#5233).
delay_reason: Found in review before release.

title: StageBatch deadlock on the single SQLite connection
symptom: Stale batch-stage rejection hung until context deadline.
how_diagnosed: A real single-connection test reproduced a deadline deadlock: a classification query on root *sql.DB while the transaction held the only connection.
delay_reason: Found by a new test during development.

title: Download schedule panics: JDownloader client created with a nil logger
symptom: The scheduled download crashed during JD Connect.
how_diagnosed: Found from the panic in jdownloader-go Connect calling j.log.Debugf on nil.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: JD packagizer rule moves downloads into subfolders and breaks renames
symptom: Episodes kept hoster file names after the JD-delegated rename shipped.
how_diagnosed: Read JD's own cfg packagizer rulelist: the enabled rule 'Create Subfolder by Packagename' changed SaveTo, so exact-destination matching found nothing (ErrNoRenamableLink).
delay_reason: Observed after the rename feature shipped; exact gap unknown.

title: Solo catch-up re-downloads the previous episode
symptom: Catch-up queued an already-downloaded episode before the real new one.
how_diagnosed: Found that the baseline used CountAtRoot while JD left finished files in package subfolders (root 5, recursive 6).
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Schedule 'Last run' stays 'Never' after completed runs
symptom: Run history showed completed scheduled runs, but the Schedule card said Never.
how_diagnosed: Found that scheduled completion was not marked before the download.run_finished event, and that the panel only loaded on mount and save.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Silent schedule-save failure: Wails string errors ignored
symptom: The Enable scheduled downloads switch reverted with no feedback.
how_diagnosed: Found that SetScheduleConfig returns a string reason instead of throwing, and the hook never checked it. Suspected a stale wails dev backend.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Missed-schedule alert does not load at startup on Today
symptom: The Today missed-schedule alert never appeared at app start.
how_diagnosed: Found that the shared runtime store was loaded only by panels not mounted on Today.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Main window shown at Windows login despite tray-first start
symptom: HKCU Run login launch showed the main window.
how_diagnosed: Found that Wails' later initial-show flow overrode WindowHide in OnStartup. Fixed with StartHidden.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Tracer-bullet startup fan-out turns catch-up changes into noisy sync.requested
symptom: Startup catch-up anime changes produced spurious sync.requested publications.
how_diagnosed: Event-bus subscription analysis of the tracer-bullet runner in the production lifecycle.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Graduated season animes misfiled in Daily Board 'Sin ver'
symptom: After Apply schedule, weekday-scheduled season animes showed in 'Sin ver'.
how_diagnosed: Checked that the DB and Episodes were correct. Found the overlay section was days[0].Day and the frontend catch-all default.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: jkanime search returns 404 for names containing '/'
symptom: Run matching for 'Ranma 1/2 (2024) 3rd Season' failed with 404.
how_diagnosed: Live probe through the real adapter and matcher, varying the characters. The site router 404s on a slash; a secondary trigram score of 0.82 was below the 0.93 threshold.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: client_telemetry piggybacked on reconcile is silently discarded by the bridge
symptom: Mobile diagnostic payloads never reached any bridge store; only 1 of the last 8 reconciles carried it.
how_diagnosed: Read raw request_body in captures through the MCP, then checked the ReconcileRequest type (no field, no DisallowUnknownFields). Resolved by the dedicated POST /api/sync/diagnostics endpoint (#9231).
delay_reason: The piggyback started around 2026-09-04 and was found 2026-09-08.

title: pairing_tokens table grows without bound
symptom: The real DB had 1,095 pairing tokens, of which 1,084 were unconsumed.
how_diagnosed: Counted rows in the real bridge.db (#4553). Found that GetPairingToken minted a token on every panel mount. Fixed with TTL, reuse and prune (#4590).
delay_reason: The rows accumulated over months of UI mounts before the analysis.

title: Wails desktop black screen from react-qr-code
symptom: The dashboard turned black in the Wails WebView after the PairingPanel was added.
how_diagnosed: Manual branch and cherry-pick isolation narrowed it to the react-qr-code render path (#2243).
delay_reason: Found while integrating the refactor.

title: Bridge watcher never emits changed_fields; mobile field-merge writes nothing
symptom: Mobile sync UI stopped updating entirely at runtime although 364 tests passed; later changes were dropped as stale.
how_diagnosed: Verified that the bridge watcher and writeback publish AnimeChangedEvent without ChangedFields, so changed_fields was always empty on the wire. Mobile now derives changes by diff.
delay_reason: Broke right after the reactive-sync-engine change shipped.

title: Mobile reconcile cursor mixes changelog ID with timestamps
symptom: Bridge updates stopped being processed after the first reconcile with bridge_changes.
how_diagnosed: Compared the sent last_changelog_id (an epoch-ms value) with the bridge's sequential changelog IDs. ListChangesAfterID found nothing.
delay_reason: Triggered when a recent bridge update started reliably returning bridge_changes.

title: Legacy Spanish keys in queued operations cause reconcile 400 after the English cutover
symptom: POST /api/sync/reconcile returned HTTP 400 for devices with pre-migration operation_log rows.
how_diagnosed: Found that durable outbox rows kept Spanish payload aliases. Added transport-time normalization.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Mobile bridge_config schema drift breaks reconcile with 400
symptom: Legacy installs could send a corrupt cursor, and /api/sync/reconcile returned '400 invalid request body'.
how_diagnosed: Found drift between schema.ts and the initial SQLite migration (missing last_changelog_id). Added a post-migration repair.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Mobile shows a false 'Bridge activo' after an offline mutation
symptom: Offline chapter +/- kept a green 'Bridge activo / Catalogo al dia' despite failed transport and pending work.
how_diagnosed: Bridge audit (#5067) showed a stopped bridge cannot emit success, so the transition was client-side. Fixed with a generation-guarded connection state.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Mobile fully isolated: RN URL polyfill breaks QR deep-link pairing
symptom: No requests reached the bridge from mobile at all.
how_diagnosed: Confirmed the bridge side was healthy and the QR contract matched. Found that the RN URL getter returns an empty hostname for custom schemes, so pairing never completes.
delay_reason: Not recorded.

title: Cover E2E: zero /api/animes/{id}/cover requests
symptom: The bridge team saw zero cover requests across two device runs (11:57 to 12:07).
how_diagnosed: Used bridge request logs plus a mobile behaviour test. The device APK predated commit 6de9ec8, so it was a deployment problem, not a code bug.
delay_reason: Diagnosed minutes after the device runs.

title: Background sync cycles hang 600 s until Android kills them; cursor frozen, operations re-sent
symptom: Reconciles arrived on an exact 600 s cadence with frozen last_changelog_id and the same pending operations, plus hours of silence (#9267).
how_diagnosed: Correlated the adb device log (task start at 12:39:20.861) with the bridge capture 840 ms later, read reconcile bodies and client_telemetry through the MCP, and found an 'Access to closed resource' write error.
delay_reason: The 600 s pattern spans weeks of captures; one operation was delivered about 43 h late.
